item.tib: khro bo'i phyag bzhes rin chen phreng ba
item.coloph: de ltar khro bo dbang chen gyi/ lag len rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba/ rgyud dang gzhung dang 'grel ba gsum dang / gshen kun mkhyen chen po'i phyag bzhes sogs la brten nas/ btsun pa rnam dag 'od zer gyis khri brtan nor bu rtse ru bkod pa dge'o//
